title: MPCFormer: A physics-informed data-driven approach for explainable socially-aware autonomous driving
abstract: arXiv:2512.03795v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Autonomous Driving (AD) vehicles still struggle to exhibit human-like behavior in highly dynamic and interactive traffic scenarios. The key challenge lies in AD's limited ability to interact with surrounding vehicles, largely due to a lack of understanding the underlying mechanisms of social interaction. To address this issue, we introduce MPCFormer, an explainable socially-aware autonomous driving approach with physics-informed and data-driven coupled social interaction dynamics. In this model, the dynamics are formulated into a discrete space-state representation, which embeds physics priors to enhance modeling explainability. The dynamics coefficients are learned from naturalistic driving data via a Transformer-based encoder-decoder architecture. translated_title: MPCFormer：一种物理信息引导的数据驱动方法，用于可解释的社交感知自动驾驶
translated_abstract: 自动驾驶（AD）车辆在高度动态和交互式交通场景中仍难以表现出类似人类的行为。关键挑战在于AD与周围车辆交互的能力有限，这主要是因为缺乏对社交互动潜在机制的理解。为解决这一问题，我们引入了MPCFormer，一种结合物理信息和数据驱动的耦合社交互动动力学的可解释社交感知自动驾驶方法。在该模型中，动力学被建模为离散状态空间表示，嵌入物理先验以增强模型可解释性。动力学系数通过基于Transformer的编码器-解码器架构从自然驾驶数据中学习。据我们所知，MPCFormer是首个明确建模多车辆社交互动动力学的模型。学习到的社交互动动力学使得能够实现...
tldr: 本文提出MPCFormer，首个将物理先验与数据驱动相结合的模型，显式建模多车辆社交互动动力学，从而提升自动驾驶的可解释性和类人行为表现。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MPCFormer, the first model that combines physics priors with data-driven methods to explicitly model multi-vehicle social interaction dynamics, enhancing interpretability and human-like behavior in autonomous driving.
